mentions.name: JSON Schemaless Stream Querying Engine
mentions.description: A stream querying engine for schemaless JSON that executes several SQL queries over a single Kafka consumer, rather than spinning up one consumer per query.
mentions.problem: Running multiple SQL queries against a Kafka stream typically requires a separate consumer for each query; this engine avoids that by sharing one consumer across queries.
mentions.source_excerpt: A json schemaless stream querying engine that would run several sql queries over the same kafka consumer (not a consumer for each query).

evidence.value: A json schemaless stream querying engine that would run several sql queries over the same kafka consumer (not a consumer for each query).
